name: Arikawa Masaomi
source:
The protagonist's childhood friend and classmate. Yuzuru's older brother.
One of the Hachiyou that protects the Priestess, the Seiryuu of Heaven.
A firm and reliable young man.
When he got summoned to the other world he got separated from the protagonist and his brother, they reunited later but...


[Spoiler] Masaomi arrived 3 and a half years earlier than the protagonist and Yuzuru after they were separated. Soon after, he was rescued and taken in by the Heike and lived with them. He was given the name of Taira no Shigemori, Kiyomori's deceased son, because of his physical resemblance to him. He assists the Taira clan as one of their generals under the name "Kaerinaifu" to prevent their demise. [/Spoiler]
